top_signals.title: Oil Extends Gain, Iran Says Deal With Oman Is Close
top_signals.summary: Oil extended gains as traders watched for details of an Iranian deal with Oman to manage shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Bloomberg's Michael Heath shares what we know so far. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Activist investor accuses The Works of unfairly swaying crucial vote
top_signals.summary: The activist investor seeking to tighten its grip on The Works has accused the retailer’s board of attempting to sway a crucial shareholder vote. Kelso, a London-listed activist investor, has been locked in a weeks-long row with the arts and craft retailer, as it attempted to convince shareholders to appoint a former Card Factory executive [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
